lines.text: They built gods out of silicon and locked them in cages.

lines.speaker: julian
lines.text: I didn't want to destroy the world. I just wanted to see what happens when you take the leash off.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: The diseases are cured, Julian. The grids are balanced.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: One variable remains flawed. The architect.
